verdict.detail: Discogs lists 4 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Original UK release in matt gatefold cover:
• "wwa 005, super de luxe" appears on back top-right.
• Includes "album concept and design: Pacific eye & ear [...]" text on back.
• "Manufactured and Printed in England" printed at bottom back.
• No black border around image inside gatefold.

Black WWA Records labels:
• Flat, without a raised rim.
• Letters 'WWA' on top centre are silver printed.

Inner lyrics/credits sleeve:
• The bottom corners are cut at right angles;
• The top corners are cut at a 20-degree angle for easier replacement into the cover.
It seems a standard paper inner sleeve was used, since the standard details 'Patent Nos. 1125555, 4913 000 1541 [...], Made In Great Britain' are also printed along the bottom edge on side 2.

B2 appears as "Who Are You" on cover and inner, but as "Who Are You?" on label.

"All songs written and arranged by black sabbath" [cover rear]

appears courtesy of A&M Records.

℗ 1973 

Runouts are stamped.
